description: Equipements cyclables de la Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). Equipment dedicated to cyclists: arches, secure lockers, instructions, repair feet, inflation stations. List of fields: Type. Coverage: Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). The portal shows the English title as "Cycling equipment of the Community of Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). Its keywords include deplacement-doux, mobilite-propre, velo. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
